name: mle
expr: mn = mle(x); me = mle(xe, 'distribution', 'exponential'); mp = mle(xp, 'distribution', 'poisson');
comment: Sig: mle(data[, 'distribution', name]). Closed-form MLE for normal (default) / exponential / poisson / lognormal. Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b. Custom 'pdf'/'logpdf'/'nloglf' deferred.
